node.statement: For every Z in S_P=M_1 tensor S_P, validated node 1.1.1.1 gives ||Z^dagger dot Z-Z^dagger Z||<=K_dot e||Z||^2, while the lower C*-axiom used in validated node 1.1.2 gives ||Z^dagger Z||>=(1-e)||Z||^2. Hence the reverse triangle inequality gives ||Z^dagger dot Z||>=(1-(K_dot+1)e)||Z||^2=(1-K_sq e)||Z||^2, with K_sq=K_dot+1. This is exactly the square premise needed at n=1; no amplified square estimate is asserted.
